WITH s1 AS (
  SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM "order" o
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
  GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
s2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM s1
),
s3 AS (
  SELECT s1.account_id AS account_id, s1.region AS region, s1.cnt AS cnt, s1.cnt - s2.avg_cnt AS diff
  FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL
),
s4 AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM s3 GROUP BY region
)
SELECT s3.account_id, s3.region, s3.cnt, s3.diff, s3.diff - s4.avg_diff AS delta
FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s3.region = s4.region
WHERE s3.diff > s4.avg_diff
ORDER BY delta DESC
LIMIT 10
